answer: River-Quartz-Basalt Provenance Scoring: each agent action logs a low-cost hardware attestation plus its transaction subgraph. Post hoc, auditors test whether the account's behavioral “quartz” signature—rare action-sequence n-grams—flows like a genuine river or pools unnaturally across accounts; basalt-like stable clusters of near-identical signatures flag farms. Attackers must diversify each sybil's workflow to beat n-gram overlap, multiplying operational cost per account.
